title: Donald Trump Challenges US Midterm Election Outcomes
summary: United States President Donald Trump has raised allegations of fraud regarding the midterm election results.
paragraphs: United States President Donald Trump brought forward allegations of voting fraud on Monday to challenge the integrity of the midterm elections, Dawn reported. His remarks followed an outcome in which the Democratic Party captured both chambers of Congress, delivering a major loss to his Republican Party, according to Dawn.

The Express Tribune reported that Trump questioned whether the November 3 midterm elections were honest. He pointed to large ballot dumps during early voting and asserted that their numbers made overcoming the deficit impossible, according to the Express Tribune. Geo News also noted that Trump returned to election fraud allegations after an initial concession.

title: Pakistan Denounces Houthi Attack on Aramco in Riyadh
summary: Pakistan has issued a condemnation following a Houthi strike directed at a Saudi Aramco building in Riyadh.
paragraphs: Pakistan has strongly condemned an attack by Houthis on the corporate office of Saudi oil firm Aramco in Riyadh, according to reports from Dawn, Aaj News, and ARY News. Dawn reported that the incident occurred on Sunday when an Aramco facility was targeted.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs demanded that the Houthi group stop all strikes directed at Saudi Arabia unconditionally and immediately, Dawn reported. ARY News also recorded Pakistan's formal condemnation of the attempted attack on the facility.

title: Pakistan Reach 281-5 on Opening Day of Sri Lanka Test
summary: Pakistan compiled 281-5 on the first day of their opening Test against Sri Lanka, supported by half-centuries from Babar Azam and two debutants.
paragraphs: According to Dawn, Pakistan concluded day one of the first Test match against Sri Lanka with a total of 281-5 on Monday. Four batters managed to record half-centuries during the innings.

The team's captain, Babar Azam, reached 50 runs, Dawn reported. In addition, two players making their Test debuts contributed significantly, with opener Tayyab Arif scoring 57 and Mohammad Taha registering 51.

title: Pakistan Secure U-19 Asia Cup Semi-Final Spot

title: Deadly Industrial Blast Hits Turkish Steel Plant
summary: An industrial explosion at a steel factory in western Turkey has killed at least 16 people after a crane collapsed into a furnace.
paragraphs: A major explosion took place at a steel factory near Izmir in western Turkey, according to Al Jazeera and BBC News. BBC News identified the facility as the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.

Casualty counts varied slightly across reports. Al Jazeera and DW reported that at least 16 people died, citing an announcement by President Recep Tayyip Erdogan following a cabinet meeting. Euronews reported that at least 17 individuals were killed and 13 others were injured. According to Euronews and Al Jazeera, the disaster was triggered when a crane carrying a boiler collapsed into an industrial furnace.

title: France Blames Iranian Cyber Unit for Supermarket Fridge Attacks
summary: French officials have accused an Iranian Revolutionary Guard cyber unit of hacking supermarket refrigerators across the country.
paragraphs: The French government has formally accused Iran's Revolutionary Guards of carrying out cyberattacks against supermarket refrigerators and freezers last month, according to BBC News, France 24, and DW. Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot described the hacking operation as unprecedented, DW and Euronews reported.

France 24 reported that the Paris prosecutor launched an investigation into Shahid Kaveh, identified as a cyber unit of the IRGC. The attacks occurred on October 11 and 12, affecting more than 1,000 stores and spoiling tons of chilled and frozen food, according to Al Jazeera, BBC News, and France 24. Euronews added that France plans to summon the Iranian ambassador over the incident.

title: Pope Leo XIV Warns Against Austerity During Argentina Visit
summary: During a pastoral trip to Argentina, Pope Leo XIV voiced concerns over government welfare cuts led by President Javier Milei.
paragraphs: Pope Leo XIV conducted a major mass in Buenos Aires that drew an estimated 2.5 million attendees, making it his largest gathering yet, according to DW. The pontiff's appearance comes in the midst of a 12-day tour across South America, Euronews reported.

During his trip, the Pope visited the Cottolengo Don Orione in Claypole, a facility supporting over 400 individuals, Euronews reported. Amid cuts enacted by President Javier Milei affecting disability care and broader social programs, DW and Euronews noted that the Pope urged the protection of society's most vulnerable populations, asserting that national progress should be measured by the treatment of those with the greatest needs.

title: Controversy Surrounds Russia's Return to Junior Ice Hockey Championship
summary: Norway has reportedly been removed from the upcoming World Juniors tournament to accommodate the return of Russia, sparking international debate and a boycott.
paragraphs: Norway stated that it has been kicked out of the upcoming major ice hockey tournament to create room for Russia, DW reported. Euronews detailed that the International Ice Hockey Federation moved Norway, which is ranked 10th, down to Division 1A to free up a spot for Russia at the event in Alberta. This adjustment followed an order from the Court of Arbitration for Sport requiring the reinstatement of Russian teams.

However, Euronews reported that the alteration is not yet officially confirmed, and Russia currently has no guarantee of receiving Canadian visas. Amid the ongoing dispute over Russia's reintroduction to global hockey, Switzerland has decided to join a boycott, according to DW.

title: Aberdeen Dismiss Stephen Robinson Following League Downturn
summary: Scottish Premiership club Aberdeen have parted ways with head coach Stephen Robinson following poor league form.
paragraphs: Aberdeen have sacked head coach Stephen Robinson, BBC News reported. The decision came after the team slid down to the second bottom position of the Scottish Premiership table.
Robinson's tenure at the club officially concluded after a heavy 4-0 defeat away against Hibernian, according to BBC News reports.
